title: oversecured/Samsung_Vulnerabilities
claim: oversecured/Samsung_Vulnerabilities — 176 vulnerabilities in Samsung preinstalled Android apps
why_good: The project highlights a critical security gap in widely used preinstalled apps, which could attract attention from enterprises concerned about device security.
value: Companies could pay for a subscription service that offers ongoing vulnerability assessments and remediation solutions for Samsung devices.
risk: The project may struggle to gain traction if larger cybersecurity firms integrate similar features into their existing products.
